digest: src/ has 3 TS files (stop, cancellation, terminal) and no test files. Several spec deviations are visible on read: S3 default poll 200ms, S6 message-prefix match, C1 extra cancellation tokens, T3 field named launchRetries, and no Q1 tests.

implementationMap.observedBehavior: Default poll is 200ms with a 1ms floor; S3 requires default 50ms and a 10ms floor.
Also matches by message prefix, which S6 forbids.

implementationMap.component: Stop intent and launch signal detection
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Stop triggers from disk intent or any aborted registered launch signal for the run path; S1 and S2 error name and message look satisfied.

implementationMap.component: Disk-read error policy in stop paths
implementationMap.evidence: readWorkflowStopIntent(cwd, runId).catch(() => undefined)  /  await readWorkflowStopIntent(cwd, runId);
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Watch path swallows read errors (S4 ok); throwIfWorkflowStopRequested propagates them (S4 ok).
Clears the interval so no periodic reads start; no disposed flag, so an in-flight check can still finish (S5 likely ok, not fully guarded).
Returned unregister removes the signal and deletes the map entry when empty (S7 looks satisfied); no test covers it.

implementationMap.evidence: if (candidate === "aborted" || candidate === "AbortError" || candidate === "ABORT_ERR" || candidate === "cancelled" || candidate === "timeout") return true;
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Accepts "cancelled" and "timeout" beyond the three exact markers C1 allows.

implementationMap.evidence: if (value.cancelled === true) return true;  /  if (details?.cancelled === true) return true;
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Boolean cancelled flags count as cancellation, which C1 does not list (C1 covers error and reason strings only).

implementationMap.evidence:
const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(entry.text);
if (parsed !== value && isWorkflowReturnedCancellation(parsed)) return true;
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Recurses into JSON text parts (C2). JSON.parse yields fresh objects and nesting is finite, so the guard is effectively redundant but no infinite recursion is possible.

implementationMap.component: Terminal semantic status for non-dynamic runs
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Maps completed with degradation to completed_degraded (T1 ok for non-dynamic runs).

implementationMap.evidence: else semanticStatus = "completed_without_semantic_result";  (reached when control is undefined)
implementationMap.observedBehavior: An unreadable controller control.json yields completed_without_semantic_result (T2 ok). Direct-dynamic path overwrites the T1 degraded status.
Sums per-task retries (T3 sum ok), but the launch field is named launchRetries; T3 requires launchRetryAttempts.

implementationMap.evidence: Glob src/**, test/**, tests/**, __tests__/** returned only the 3 src .ts files; Grep for test/spec/vitest/jest found no files
implementationMap.observedBehavior: No unit tests for S, C, or T items exist in the repo, so Q1 is not met.

unmappedAreas: store.js and types.js are imported but not in the repo (SPEC says excluded)
tsconfig.json and node_modules not inspected; typecheck not run
notes: Recent commit 654f639 (poll less often; treat cancelled/timeout as cancellation; shorter retry field name) appears to be the source of the S3, C1, and T3 deviations.
Stage maps evidence only; conformance is not claimed here.
